build_spotify_playback_control: build a Spotify playback controller that supports play, pause, next, previous, seek, and volume actions
create_spotify_search_function: create a Spotify search function that queries tracks, albums, artists, playlists, shows, or episodes
manage_spotify_playlists: manage Spotify playlists by listing, creating, adding items, removing items, and updating details
build_spotify_library_manager: build a Spotify library manager that lists, saves, and removes saved tracks or albums
transfer_spotify_playback_device: transfer Spotify playback to a different device from a list of available Spotify Connect devices
